==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis.
This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster.)
I traveled to a medieval world of knights dressed in spike armor. (Spike World has a lot of wet black soil everywhere. Towering, gray, stone, medieval castles with massive sloped walls are scattered across the landscape. It is a world where strength determines leadership. The knights of this world wear spiked metal armor.)
I helped them fight off a troll invasion using Lucid Light tidal wave constructs.
The kingdom leader, a Were-Porcupine warrior princess, chose me to be their new king.
